You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def check(qname,rowidx,colidx,source_lines,rev=False):

  src=source_lines[len(source_lines)-1-j if rev else j]
  checks.append((q in rotations(src), q in rotations(src[::-1])))
 print(qname,checks)
cols=[[I2[y][x] for y in range(8)] for x in range(8)]
check('TR',range(8),range(8,16),cols)
check('BL',range(8,16),range(8),cols,True)
check('BR',range(8,16),range(8,16),I2,True)

def offs(src, out):
 return [k for k in range(len(src)) if src[k:]+src[:k]==out]
def get_offs(quadrant, rs, cs, src_lines, order=False, flip=False):
 vals=[]
 for j,y in enumerate(rs):
  src=src_lines[len(src_lines)-1-j if order else j]
  if flip:src=src[::-1]
  q=[quadrant[y][x] for x in cs]
  cand=offs(src,q)
  vals.append(cand)
 return vals
# Demo2 offset choices
cols2=[[I2[y][x] for y in range(8)] for x in range(8)]
for name,rs,cs,src,order,flip in [('TR',range(8),range(8,16),cols2,False,True),('BL',range(8,16),range(8),cols2,True,False),('BR',range(8,16),range(8,16),I2,True,True)]:
 print(name,get_offs(O2,rs,cs,src,order,flip))
# demo1
for name,rs,cs,src,order,flip in [('TR',range(14),range(14,28),cols1,False,True),('BL',range(14,28),range(14),cols1,True,False),('BR',range(14,28),range(14,28),I,True,True)]:

def cw(a): return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
def ccw(a): return [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
def rot180(a): return [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
def tile(a):
 t,r,b,l= a,cw(a),ccw(a),rot180(a)
 return [t[i]+r[i] for i in range(len(a))]+[b[i]+l[i] for i in range(len(a))]
T2=tile(I2)
print(T2==O2)
T1=tile(I)
print(len(T1),len(T1[0]))
